utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up donations fast—though I’m still waiting to hear the final count. I’ll let you know as soon as I get the latest.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Tess — I’ll hold off on assuming anything until there’s a confirmed count and source.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, that’s the safe way to do it. I’ll wait for the confirmed number and then pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan to folks and help get the word out. Let’s make sure everyone hears the same version.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate it. I’ll send the latest details again once I’m back on top of my messages.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m in for the repair drive. Tell me where and when.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, Leo — I heard it’s happening near the community center on Saturday morning. I’ll swing by and confirm the exact time, then let you know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’d like to verify the repair list first before we commit to anything. If you have the details, I’ll double-check them carefully.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’d rather keep it simple and go one step at a time—what’s the next thing that needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: The next thing on my list is to check the loose wiring on the drive housing. If that’s sound, we can move on to the power coupler.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Alright, I’ll check the loose wiring on the drive housing first. If it looks good, we can move on to the power coupler.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m in — I’ll help spread the word about the repair drive and get folks from both groups involved.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — that would help a lot. If you can keep it around school pickup times, I can actually make it work.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I like having a fixed plan for the repair drive, Oren—once we pick a time and a job list, I’d rather stick to it. What’s the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the fixed plan sounds best. What time did you say we settled on again?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: Saturday at 10, and we stick to the same job list we already agreed on.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away and make sure everyone hears about it!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — could you send me the exact wording first? I’d like the plan nailed down before we start.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll send the exact wording over now so you can approve it before I share anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve mostly just been hearing bits and pieces from folks around here. If you’re heading to the repair drive, I’d love to know what you’ve learned.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the basics so far, but I’m still double-checking the details so I don’t send anyone the wrong info. If you want, I can keep you posted as soon as I know the time and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’m still piecing things together myself. Just let me know when you’ve got the time and what folks should bring.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still waiting on the final repair list before I settle anything. If it comes in early, I’ll stick to that plan.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I’ll wait for the final list and stick to the plan we agreed on.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — once the final list comes in, I’ll review it and we can move ahead from there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not sure yet, but I can check the repair drive and let you know. If it’s urgent, I’d rather confirm before saying more.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that works — I’ll wait for your update. If you hear anything, just let me know and I’ll piece the rest together.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I will. I’ll let you know once I’ve checked it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can pitch in with tools and a bit of labor. Just point me at what needs fixing, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what tools are you bringing, and what time can you be there?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a basic tool kit, drill, hammer, screwdrivers, and a pry bar. I’m flexible on time, but I can probably swing by late morning or early afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive details nailed down, Bo — just point me to the exact location and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — send me the exact spot and I’ll swing by when I’m between rides.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — head to the lot off Cedar Lane, right by the old maple tree, and I’ll meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can help out with the repair drive—just point me to whatever’s broken and I’ll bring my tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. The main issue is the loose hinge on the community shed door—if you can take a look, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I’ll take a look at that shed hinge and see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we should pin down the details now — who’s collecting what, where it’s going, and by when. Once we have the first plan written down, I’d rather stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not changing course without a written plan or a source for the details. If you want me in, confirm who’s handling each part and when it’s due.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds fair — let’s write it down now: one person for collections, one for delivery, and a clear deadline. If we keep to the first plan, I’ll feel much better.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think the repair drive could really bring everyone together—if we keep it simple and welcoming, people from all the groups will show up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds right to me, Jules. If we keep it simple and follow through on what we promise, folks will feel welcome.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Exactly—let’s keep the promises clear and make it easy for anyone to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll jot down the repair drive details carefully, then we can check what supplies and commitments are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll catch up from your notes and help fill in the missing supplies and commitments.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — I’m keeping a clean list of what’s confirmed and what’s still missing. As soon as you’re ready, I’ll add the repair drive supplies and any commitments we’ve agreed on.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a good bit of support already—people seem really ready to pitch in. I’m still waiting to confirm the full details, but it’s looking promising!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great to hear—I can probably help, but I’ll need the full details first so I can see what fits between school pickup and the kids’ activities.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I’ll grab the confirmed details and send them your way as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m on it — I just need the quick version of where and when for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — the repair drive is at the community lot on Maple, this Saturday at 10am. I’ll send the full details in the group chat too, just so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Maple community lot, Saturday at 10. I’ll keep an eye on the group chat for the rest.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I can help out with the repair drive—just point me to what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Start with the donation table and sort the usable tools first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it — I’ll start with the donation table and sort out the usable tools first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m all in on the repair drive — I’ll spread the word fast and make sure everyone feels invited. If there’s a list or a flyer, send it my way and I’ll help get folks there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be really helpful, Quinn—thank you. I’ll send over the flyer and the sign-up list as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—send them when you’re ready, and I’ll start sharing right away. We’ll get a good crowd there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive details straight—location, timing, and next steps. Tell me what you need confirmed, and I’ll pin it down.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Opal. Just confirm the exact location and start time, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s at the north lot off Maple, and we start at 9:00 AM sharp. If you’re there a few minutes early, I’ll already have things lined up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs repair, and what’s the deadline for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t confirmed the full list yet, so I’d rather double-check before saying. If you send me the items and deadline, I’ll verify them carefully.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I need the exact item list and the deadline before I can proceed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s picking up steam—folks are dropping off tools and spare parts all afternoon. If you need anything moved over there, I can run it along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s kind of you, Ira. I might’ve got the days mixed up, but I’ll bring by whatever I can if I find it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No worries—those dates get tangled easy. I’ll keep an ear out, and if I hear they need anything specific, I’ll let you know.
